ADURA®Rigid

Withstands all of life's moments.

What makes ADURA®Rigid different is it's solid core that gives the floor superior indentation resistance and it doesn't need to acclimate before it's installed and it can handle wide temperature ranges, like a cabin in the middle of winter or an enclosed lanai in Florida on a hot summer day.
